component.name: Surfex
component.summary: Movies and Series media library and BitTorrent player

description.p: Surfex keeps track of what you are watching and plays movies and series in a real mpv window rather than a browser video tag — so half-downloaded MKVs, HEVC, AV1 and DTS all just play. It is driven as happily by a TV remote as by a mouse.

Surfex hosts no content and indexes no content. It ships with no sources configured, searches nothing on its own, and will not suggest anywhere to look: a source is a URL you add yourself under Settings. With none configured it is a general-purpose torrent client with a very good player attached.

ul.li: An embedded mpv window with hardware decoding, subtitle tracks and audio track switching
A BitTorrent engine that streams while it downloads, so playback starts before the file does
A local watch history, favourites and watchlist — no account, no server, nothing synced
Subtitle search, download and resync against the audio
Twenty-eight themes, or one generated from a colour or a picture you choose
